description: Public channel post content-addressing + the recipient-exclusion rule (SPEC §8.3.2 + §3 amendment). A v1 chat-channel post is PUBLIC: plaintext body, no recipient set, no AEAD. post_id = SHA-256(canonical(content)) per §0; the post d-tag = 'oc-lock-chat-msg:' || base64url(SHA-256(channel_id || ':' || post_id)). The write_proof (§8.3.3) is committed in the content; the author device sig + the write_proof control_sig both sign post_id and are attached to the event, NOT in the hashed content. A chat-channel envelope carrying a non-empty recipients[] is E_CHANNEL_RECIPIENTS.
notes: post_id = hex(sha256(canonical(post)+'\n')); d-tag suffix = base64url-unpadded(sha256(utf8(channel_id+':'+post_id))). The body 'gm — sats as signal' contains a non-ASCII em-dash (U+2014) — canonicalization is over UTF-8 bytes, no escaping. A reader rejects the post with E_CHANNEL_RECIPIENTS if it rides as a chat-channel envelope with any recipients[].
